french.diacritics: Do not deduct missing French accents, but always display the corrected accented form.
french.writing: Use a criterion checklist. A model is an example, not the only accepted response. Return Review needed when a plausible free response cannot be judged safely.

latin.wordOrder: Accept normal Latin word-order variation only when every required form is present and no unrelated extra token is added.
latin.unorderedSets: Accept commas, slashes, semicolons, 'and' or new lines in any order; identify missing and extra forms separately.

biology.typedTerms: Accept listed scientific synonyms and abbreviations only. Do not accept a related but different term.
biology.markPoints: Award each distinct mark point once. A longer sentence can earn several points only when each causal idea is present.
biology.calculations: Check method, numerical tolerance and unit separately. Show the source working after submission.
biology.longAnswers: Use mark-point or criterion checklists with manual/parent-review fallback; never exact-string mark an extended response.
biology.diagrams: Compare label-to-anchor mappings, not raw typed order.
